title: 進路セミナーⅠ
subtitle: Career Planning Seminar I
educationalGoal:
This course is for an educational goal of the Department of Management Systems to acquire "Career Design Ability". Students will:
(1) confirm the learning style including self-study, and get ready to become a human resource who can stand up by yourself and contribute to society,
(2) Recognize your ability and personality correctly, continue self-development, improve self-management ability and continue to strive for self-realization.
advice:
This class is conducted in departmental units.

(1) Guidance
(2) Lecture by career advisor
(3) Self-analysis
(4) Lectures / practices by career development department staff
(5) Corporate research (mainly local companies)
(6) Employment practice exam
requiredKnowledge:
Career seminars I and II, which are held in the 1st semester and the 2nd semester, are mainly courses for job hunting.
All students should take these courses whether you are going to plan taking Master’s degree or getting a job.
The results of this study will be a reference material for job placement.

activityGoals.body: Be able to deeply consider the relationship between life design and career path.
Be able to think and act as needed to find out the right profession.
Be able to define their own policy and goal regarding their professions and to explain logically to others.
Be able to improve their own knowledge, skills, abilities and capacity to achieve their own professional goals.
